3. Top 3 Logic Gaps

  1. Net Cash Sign Convention Contradiction: Net Cash (defined as Cash - Debt) is listed as a negative value (-22.9B), which mathematically signifies a net debt position. However, it is explicitly labeled as "Strong", indicating an inverted sign convention or narrative mismatch.
  2. Expectation Gap Sign Discrepancy: The reverse DCF shows an Implied FCF Growth of 11.6% against a Representative Growth of 18.6%. The report calculates an Expectation Gap of +7.0% (meaning market expectations are lower/conservative), but standard financial logic dictates that required growth lower than historical growth is a negative expectation hurdle (undemanding).
